prompts.app:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Addons Forever desktop app icon master, 1024x1024 RGBA PNG.
Primary request: Flat vector-style app icon: one centered rounded-square tile, subtle vertical gradient from midnight #182B4A at top to royal blue #3A6DF4 at bottom. Center a bold luminous white fingerprint-key hybrid: a simple recognizable key silhouette with an open circular bow, short shaft, and a tooth end made of three thick curved fingerprint ridges. Make it read as BOTH key and fingerprint, with very few, well-spaced lines and strong negative space. A few tiny warm golden window-light glints in the two lower corners. Thin crisp light-blue border.
Composition: tile nearly fills square with a small equal transparent margin, rounded corners; glyph large, centered and clear at 16px.
Style: minimal flat clean vector shapes, modern Fluent / Windows 11 icon polish; subtle glow only, no bevel, no extruded sides, no photorealism, no text or letters, no brand logos or existing game IP.
Background: actual transparent alpha outside tile, never a checkerboard pattern.
prompts.tray:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Addons Forever 16px / 32px colored system-tray icon master.
Input image: reference and edit target, the app icon. Preserve the same white fingerprint-key glyph shape, same upright orientation, same midnight #182B4A to royal #3A6DF4 tile, same rounded square silhouette.
Change only the details for a small system-tray variant: remove all golden corner lights, all external glow, all fine border lines, and any bevel. Make the white glyph thick and large, with large transparent-color gaps between the three fingerprint ridges, legible at 16 pixels. A compact clean flat tile with just the glyph.
Square composition, near edge-to-edge rounded tile with a narrow equal clear outer margin. True transparent alpha outside tile. No text, no shadow, no 3D, no texture, no other symbols.
prompts.tray-mono:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Addons Forever macOS menu-bar template icon master.
Input image: app icon reference / edit target. Extract and preserve ONLY the upright fingerprint-key glyph shape: open round key bow, straight downward stem, three separated curved fingerprint ridges at the tooth end. Keep that glyph's orientation and proportions, strengthen small-size legibility.
Remove the blue rounded tile completely, remove golden lights, remove border, remove ALL glow and shadows. Output ONLY one pure white (#FFFFFF) flat silhouette made of the solid key bow/stem and three curved ridges, on actual transparent alpha. Empty key-bow center and gaps remain fully transparent. Very crisp smooth edges, square centered image with even 10 percent clear margins. Designed to be readable at 16x16 and 32x32. No gray fill, no background color, no checkerboard, no text, no 3D.
prompts.splash:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: Addons Forever optional first-run splash artwork, final 1024x512 PNG.
Input image: style reference for the fingerprint-key glyph. Preserve the same distinctive open circular key bow, vertical stem and three separate curved fingerprint ridges.
Primary request: the white fingerprint-key symbol glowing softly at the center of a dark midnight-blue starfield, without the square tile behind it. Along the lower horizon, a few faint folder-tab silhouettes form a cozy little city skyline, hinting at an AddOns folder. A handful of warm amber windows punctuate the faint silhouettes.
Composition: wide 2:1, centered compact glowing glyph, generous dark negative space, low subtle skyline along bottom. Smooth midnight #182B4A to deep royal-blue ambient lighting, sparse small stars, cozy and minimal.
No text, no actual folder labels, no logos, no recognizable game characters or IP. Transparent-safe: true alpha outside softly feathered outer edges, continuous dark sky inside. Final intended size 1024x512.

badge-update.generation:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Addons Forever update-available badge, square transparent PNG master for 16x16 and 32x32 exports.
Primary request: One simple flat vivid green upward arrow that blends into a small leaf-shaped badge. The silhouette must read instantly as UP / update: broad pointed arrow head, short strong stem, subtle leaf curve on one side. Bright fresh green, one tiny warm pale-gold highlight, very restrained glow.
Composition: one centered compact symbol occupying most of canvas with even margins, crisp geometric silhouette and broad solid shapes that remain legible at 16 pixels.
Constraints: actual transparent background, transparent outside the green arrow, no blue tile, no circle background, no text, no numbers, no other symbols, no checkerboard. Flat design, no 3D, no bevel.
badge-update.refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Addons Forever update badge for 16x16 and 32x32 transparent PNG export.
Input image: edit target, the existing green upward arrow leaf badge.
Change ONLY its fill treatment for small-size contrast: replace all dark green center shading and all gradients with one SOLID UNIFORM BRIGHT LIGHT GREEN fill, #63E6A5. Keep the exact upright upward-arrow-plus-leaf outer silhouette, broad arrow head and short stem, same composition and margins. Keep only one tiny warm pale-gold leaf-vein highlight. No dark center. No bevel. Flat vector icon. All green interior pixels fully opaque with no texture, empty exterior truly transparent alpha. It must read very clearly at 16px on a midnight-blue user interface.
No text, no additional objects, no circle or tile background, no checkerboard.
